  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message

          type: string

          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      title: Specialty

      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1

      required:

      title: Owner fields

          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner

            household). Write-only; never returned in responses.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

        - lastName

        - city
        - telephone

              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is
                a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID

                last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with

              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'

              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true

All 34 tests pass with a green build. Here's a summary of the change.

## What I implemented

`membershipTier` now returns `'GOLD'` when the owner's household (owners sharing the same `householdId`) has 3+ members after the create; otherwise the existing SILVER/BRONZE rules apply.

Following the codebase's existing pattern (`namesakeCount` is computed at create time and stored on the `Owner`, then the mapper derives the tier from it), I did the same for household size:

1. **`Owner.java`** — added a `householdSize` field (`household_size` column) with getter/setter.

2. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — after household backfill and setting `householdId`, computes and stores `householdSize` = existing members carrying the shared `householdId` + 1 (the new owner). Added a `countHouseholdMembers(householdId)` helper that returns 0 for owners not in any household (null `householdId`), so those stay a household of one.

3. **`OwnerMapper.membershipTier`** — returns `'GOLD'` when `householdSize >= 3`, otherwise falls through to the unchanged SILVER/BRONZE logic.

4. **Schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added the `household_size` column. Tests run on `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so the column had to exist in `schema.sql`.

5. **`openapi.yml`** — updated the `membershipTier` description to document the GOLD rule (field is a plain string, no enum to constrain).

Because the size is captured at each owner's own create time, the GOLD promotion reflects "3+ members after this create" per the spec — the third household member reads back as `GOLD` (verified by `Cp23Tests`), while the existing SILVER/BRONZE tests (`Cp15Tests`) and household-id tests (`Cp11Tests`) remain green.
